title: Limit an input range
summary: FastAPI: Limit an input range. Try n=0 and n=11.
introduction: Query can add rules such as a minimum and maximum. Open GET /page?n=3.
learningObjectives: Limit an input range with FastAPI

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Limit an input range

blocks.text: Query checks the bounds as well as the type. The allowed value 3 reaches the function.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Type checks alone do not enforce a useful range.
